input: Owner pasted an interview transcript with a clothing designer and asked to work on it: AI-assisted clothing design (voice and point-and-click design, fabric choice and prices from manufacturers, manufacturing, store, marketing, VR later).
follow_up_inputs: Owner pasted a second interview: sunglasses with the brand's logo on a stock frame and case (about 20 EUR to make, 60-70 to sell), full-wardrobe sets started small with pricing tiers and audience targeting, in-house plus partner brands, and virtual try-on.
task: Owner request R-0005: AI-assisted clothing design studio from an interview transcript

errors.what: First garment drawing was about twice too tall for its cm scale, so tech-pack measurements from the shoulder were wrong; caught when the quote request said a front print started 52 cm below the shoulder. Redrawn at 6 px/cm to size-M proportions, with a test that checks width and length.
Supplier CSV parser accepted 'abc' as 0; caught by a test, fixed.
Wardrobe planner first produced 'cream jeans' and linen in a cold-winter capsule; items now carry the colours they are made in and season/climate filter eligibility; tests cover both.

doc_friction.issue: Preflight stops at sync_tree_counts --check after a 5+ minute start; a new venture always changes that count, so running sync_tree_counts.py first could be part of the new-venture steps in PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK.md section 7.
'the page builds the header intake parses' fails on main, independent of this change.

deviations.why: The interviewed designer said they would prefer the software not be open source. The repository's licensing rule (MIT) is a hard limit, so the software is MIT; the designer's own designs, artwork and brand are never committed (everything stays in their browser). Raised with the owner in the session reply rather than decided silently.
deviations.did: Shipped MIT; flagged the conflict to the owner

deviations.why: The request's ask is the owner's paraphrase with the designer's name removed (a private individual); the marketing page quotes three short, unattributed phrases from the interview.
deviations.result: no personal data in the tree

notes: Local verification: node --test ventures/clothing-design-studio/*.test.mjs 54/54 pass; run_venture_tests.py clothing-design-studio ok; clauses.mjs 3 pages ok; router validate ok; driven in headless Chromium (commands, variants, pick, drag, costing), no console errors, no horizontal scroll at 390px. venture-preflight run after sync_tree_counts.py. Follow-up in the same PR: sunglasses.html + eyewear.mjs, wardrobe.html + wardrobe.mjs, shared sellingSide in costing.mjs; 69/69 tests; both pages driven in headless Chromium, no console errors, no horizontal scroll at 390px.
